references.text: The introduction to the counting of the tribe of Dan, which verse 39 gives the result of.
The second census of the tribe of Dan, showing the change in the size of the tribe after the wilderness journey.
Dan's birth as a son of Jacob through Bilha, the origin of the tribe of Dan.
Dan's son Hushim is mentioned among those who went to Egypt with Jacob, the early history of the tribe.
Jacob's blessing over Dan, a prophecy about the future of the tribe.
The placement of the tribe of Dan in the camp and their number are repeated in connection with the camp arrangement.
The tribe of Dan in the marching order when the Israelites broke camp.
